title: Understand My Partner Better
description: Fill in all the fields in brackets before using this prompt. If you want the AI to analyze a specific situation from a photo, attach the relevant image where indicated.
prompt:
About me:
- Name: [Your name]
- Age: [Your age]

About my partner:
- Name: [Partner's name]
- Age: [Partner's age]
- Relationship length: [How long you have been together]

What happened:
[Describe the situation in detail]

What I said or did:
[Describe your words or actions]

What my partner said or did:
[Describe your partner's words or actions]

If the situation is shown in a message, conversation, screenshot, or photo, attach the image here:
[Attach image if applicable]

Analyze the situation from both perspectives. Explain what each person might be feeling, what could have caused the misunderstanding, and how I could communicate my thoughts calmly and clearly.

If an image is attached, use the information visible in the image as additional context. Do not invent information that cannot be seen or understood from the image.

Do not simply decide who is right or wrong. Focus on understanding both perspectives and improving communication.

title: Plan a Memorable Date
description: Fill in all the fields in brackets before using this prompt. Add a photo if you want the AI to consider a specific location, outfit, venue, or other visual detail when creating the date ideas.
prompt:
Location: [City or area]
Budget: [Your budget and currency]
Available time: [Number of hours]
Relationship stage: [First date / New relationship / Long-term relationship / Married]
Our interests: [Things we both enjoy]
Things we do not like: [Things to avoid]
Special occasion: [Birthday / Anniversary / Normal date / Other]

If there is a specific location, venue, outfit, or visual detail that you want the AI to consider, attach the image here:
[Attach image if applicable]

Give me 10 creative date ideas based on the information above.

Avoid generic suggestions such as simply going to a restaurant or watching a movie unless they are combined with a more creative activity.

For each idea, include:
- What we would do
- Approximate cost
- How long it would take
- What we need to bring or prepare
- Why it could be memorable

If an image is attached, use the visible details from the image when relevant. Do not assume details that cannot be clearly identified.

title: Start a Deeper Conversation
description: Fill in the fields in brackets before using this prompt. You can also attach an image of something meaningful to you or your partner if you want the AI to create questions based on it.
prompt:
We have been together for: [Relationship length]
Our ages: [Your age] and [Partner's age]

Things we already know about each other:
[Write a few things you already know]

Topics we enjoy talking about:
[Topics you both enjoy]

Topics we would like to understand better:
[Topics you want to explore]

If you have a photo, screenshot, memory, object, place, or other visual reference that you want the questions to be based on, attach it here:
[Attach image if applicable]

Create 15 meaningful conversation questions that can help us:
- Learn something new about each other
- Talk about our future
- Share childhood memories
- Understand each other's dreams and fears
- Discuss our values and expectations
- Strengthen our emotional connection

Mix the questions between playful, romantic, deep, thoughtful, and unexpected.

If an image is attached, use it as inspiration when creating relevant questions. Do not make assumptions about information that cannot be determined from the image.

Avoid generic questions such as "What is your favorite movie?"

title: Analyze Your Relationship
description: You can copy the prompt by watching a single advertisement.
prompt: Based on everything I’ve previously told you about my relationship, hold up a mirror to me.Be honest about my own behavior, patterns, blind spots, and contradictions — even if some of it is difficult or uncomfortable for me to hear. Point out things I may be ignoring, rationalizing, or failing to notice about the way I communicate, react, attach, or handle conflict.Don’t just validate me or take my side. Look at my behavior objectively and tell me what I might need to take responsibility for, what patterns I may be repeating, and what I could do differently.Base your analysis only on what I’ve actually shared with you. Don’t make assumptions or invent details.Most importantly, respond in the language I normally use when talking to you, and keep your tone natural, direct, and conversational.
